Hidden_Test_Description: Verifies reset values and masked read-after-write behaviour of the GPIO control and group registers across pins 8 through 39 using CSR access
Hidden_Remarks: When reading default values the DIN bit can read as 1 unless input is forced low; forcing DIN low can raise the bit-level select and cause a mismatch with the expected default
Hidden_Test_Steps_Procedure:
1) chk_rst_val() is called to iterate i=0..CNT-1, computing addr from addr_array[i]; if skip_rst_array[i]==1 or read_mask_array[i]==0, continue; read_reg(addr) to data_rd, mask with 0xfffffffe into data; compare against default_value_array[i]; on mismatch, def_fail_cnt++ and print error
2) chk_rd_wr() iterates six patterns in chk_val; for each pattern sets data_wr, then for i=0..CNT-1: if skip_array[i]==1 continue; if write_mask_array[i]==0 continue; else write_reg(addr, (data_wr & write_mask_array[i]))
3) In the readback phase for each i: if skip_array[i]==1 or write_mask_array[i]==0 or read_mask_array[i]==0 continue; else data_rd = (read_reg(addr) & read_mask_array[i]); compute wr_n = (write_mask_array[i] ^ 0xffffffff); compute exp_val = ((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | (wr_n & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])); compare data_rd==exp_val; on mismatch, wr_fail_cnt++ and print error
4) At end of test_case(), if def_fail_cnt>0 or wr_fail_cnt>0 call finish(1) else finish(0)
Hidden_Validation_Acceptance_Criteria: All register reads at reset match default_value_array after masking; for each written pattern the readback masked value equals exp_val; finish(0) indicates pass

Hidden_Test_Description: Configures per-pin input mode and negative-edge detection, enables one-bit-at-a-time group interrupt, generates a falling edge on each pin, and validates per-pin/group raw status and system status clear
Hidden_Remarks: Uses bounded timeout loops; arms int_pend before stimulus; initializes external pad driver to high
Hidden_Test_Steps_Procedure:
1) In test_case(), optionally enable GIC for GPIO0/1 based on compile-time macros; write MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1 with LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO{0/1}_INTR to enable system routing
2) write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xffffffff) to drive all pads high
3) For i=0..31: addr1=MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + i*4; write_reg(addr1, (1<<20)|(1<<18)|(1<<16)); wait_on(10)
4) For i=0..31: wr_val=1<<i; write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1, wr_val); write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, wr_val); wait_on(10); set int_pend=1; write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xffffffff); wait_on(30); write_reg(0xA0243ffc, ~wr_val); poll while(int_pend && timeout--) wait_on(10); on timeout, printf error and test_err++
5) finish(test_err)
6) In Default_IRQHandler(): compute local_wr=1<<i; set int_pend=0; write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xffffffff); raddr=MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + i*4; rdata=read_reg(raddr); if ((rdata & 0x1)!=0) test_err++; if ((rdata & 0x2)!=0x0) { rdata_grp=read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1); if ((rdata_grp & local_wr)==0) test_err++; raddr2=MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + i*4; write_reg(raddr2, (1<<20)|(1<<16)); write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1, local_wr); rdata_grp=read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1); if (rdata_grp!=0x0) test_err++; write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1, LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO{0/1}_INTR); GIC_ClearIRQ(87/88); } else { test_err++; }
Hidden_Validation_Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when for each i: (rdata & 0x1)==0 after negedge, per-pin raw indicated via (rdata & 0x2)!=0, group status bit set then cleared to 0, system RAW_STCR1 cleared, and no loop timeouts occur; finish(0)

Hidden_Test_Description: Configures posedge detection on GPIOs 8..39, sets input mode via group IO_CTRL, enables group interrupt, then generates rising edges per pin and validates group status set/clear and system status clear with re-enabling
Hidden_Remarks: Masks group interrupt during ISR, uses bounded wait loops, and restores pad to low between iterations
Hidden_Test_Steps_Procedure:
1) In test_case(), enable GIC for GPIO0/1 and write MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1 to enable system routing
2) For i=0..31: write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + i*4, 0x00020000) to enable posedge
3) wait_on(10); write GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP1..4 with 0x000000FF to configure input mode; wait_on(10)
4) write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, 0xFFFFFFFF)
5) For i=0..31: write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0x00000000); wait_on(10); int_pend=1; write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xFFFFFFFF); bounded wait while(int_pend==1 && --timeout>0) wait_on(10); on timeout, printf error, test_err++, break; drive low and wait_on(10)
6) finish(test_err)
7) In Default_IRQHandler(): wr_val=1<<i; int_pend=0; read INTR1_INTR_STS1 to rdata_grp; write INTR1_INTR_EN1=0 to mask; if (rdata_grp & 0xffffffff)!=0 print success else print error and test_err++; for j=0..31: write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + j*4, 0x00010000); wait_on(2); read INTR1_INTR_STS1; if (rdata_grp==0) success else print error and test_err++; clear system RAW_STCR1 for GPIO0/1 then verify cleared; re-enable INTR1_INTR_EN1=0xFFFFFFFF; clear GIC
Hidden_Validation_Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when group status indicates an interrupt per rising edge then clears to 0 after W1C per-pin raw clears, system RAW_STCR1 is cleared, and no timeouts occur; finish(0)
